reason: Recovered unfinished work from an older Agentonomy run.
title: Recovered work
originalRequest: Establish a standardized weather journal framework and recording protocol for the lighthouse station.
latestMessage: Establish a standardized weather journal framework and recording protocol for the lighthouse station.

steps.title: Define Meteorological Schema
steps.instruction: Specify core variables to be logged daily, including barometric pressure, wind velocity, wind direction, ambient temperature, and visibility.
steps.acceptance: All variables defined with corresponding standard SI and maritime units.
steps.result: Completed the schema specification. Standardized on hPa for pressure, knots for wind, and Celsius for temperature.

steps.title: Design Logbook Grid Layout
steps.instruction: Create a physical ledger column template for manual entries under low-light conditions.
steps.acceptance: Columns must be legible, organized, and fit standard landscape paper binding.
steps.result: Template designed and test-printed. Column spacing allows for hand-written logs with heavy pencils.

steps.title: Formulate Barometer Calibration Schedule
steps.instruction: Document weekly mercury barometer calibration procedures against regional baseline standards, accounting for altitude offset.
steps.acceptance: Document includes altitude-correction math (+12 meters above sea level).
steps.result: Calibration procedures formalized. Altitude correction tables have been appended to the logbook manual.

steps.title: Ingest Historical Logs
steps.instruction: Cross-reference and transcribe five years of legacy scrapbook records into the newly structured format.
steps.acceptance: All historical wind and pressure data mapped without gaps or conversion errors.
steps.result: Currently on Attempt 3. Attempt 1 failed due to illegibility of 1894 storm records. Attempt 2 failed due to mathematical discrepancies in imperial-to-metric conversions. Currently correcting 1895 tide offsets; data migration is 60% complete.

steps.title: Implement Wind Classification Table
steps.instruction: Develop a visual Beaufort-to-knots conversion reference matrix for the journal appendix.
steps.acceptance: Matrix spans Beaufort forces 0 through 12 with specific sea state indicator descriptions.
steps.result: Conversion matrix created and checked against maritime reference manuals.

steps.title: Draft Cloud Cover Estimation Protocols
steps.instruction: Write instructions for estimating sky coverage using the Okta scale, with reference diagrams.
steps.acceptance: Instructions must define fog handling procedures as 8 oktas with limited vertical visibility.
steps.result: Okta guidelines completed. Fog exception logic integrated successfully.

steps.title: Define Astronomical Tide Logging Rules
steps.instruction: Outline rules for logging daily low and high tide heights and times matching the semidiurnal tide pattern.
steps.acceptance: Logging schedule aligns with local Admiralty tide tables.
steps.result: Tide logging guidelines completed and verified against current tidal predictions.

steps.title: Design Precipitation Measurement Protocols
steps.instruction: Specify rain gauge measurement procedures, including snow water equivalent calculations for winter.
steps.acceptance: Procedures must require daily observations at exactly 09:00 UTC.
steps.result: Rain gauge protocol drafted and finalized, including the winter melting procedure.

steps.title: Identify Visibility Landmarks
steps.instruction: Document geographical landmarks at known distances to serve as daytime visual range estimators.
steps.acceptance: Landmarks must span a range from 0.5 to 10.0 nautical miles from the lighthouse tower.
steps.result: Completed landmark identification chart. Verified coordinates and distances using regional charts.

steps.title: Draft Anomalous Weather Alert Criteria
steps.instruction: Define threshold criteria for issuing special weather warnings, such as rapid barometric pressure drops.
steps.acceptance: Threshold criteria must be clearly highlighted and distinct from routine observation rules.
steps.result: Alert criteria formulated. Placed a high-contrast visual reference sheet at the beginning of the journal.

steps.title: Audit Journal Compliance
steps.instruction: Audit the entire journal structure, templates, and protocols against national meteorological standards.
steps.acceptance: Final audit must find zero discrepancies in measurements, units, or documentation.
steps.result: Audit complete. All templates and protocols conform to official meteorological guidelines.
